Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of WMT.
We delivered record revenue of $5.5 billion this quarter, representing 18% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 187 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2020.
We generated $3.0 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Operating income reached $10.8 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
